name: Brass: Birmingham

rounds.endCondition: Canal Era and Rail Era each end after all players use their last cards

categories.label: Canal Era: links
categories.hint: Per link tile: 1 VP per VP icon at each adjacent location.

categories.label: Canal Era: flipped industries
categories.labelVi: Kỳ Kênh: công nghiệp đã lật
categories.hint: Sum of VPs printed on your flipped industry tiles.

categories.label: Rail Era: links
categories.hint: Same as canal era, using rail links.

categories.label: Rail Era: flipped industries
categories.labelVi: Kỳ Ray: công nghiệp đã lật
categories.hint: All your flipped industry tiles on board (level 2+ also scored in canal era).

categories.label: Shortfall penalties
categories.hint: Enter actual VP lost during play, capped by VP available at the time, not unpaid money. Do not subtract again if already included in an entered net era subtotal.

categories.label: Income level (tiebreak)
categories.hint: Income level number, not income track space.

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, those players draw.

notes: VPs are only awarded at the end of each era (links first, then flipped industries; unflipped industries score nothing). Link tiles are removed as scored; level-1 industries are removed after canal era. If you enter the final VP marker position instead, use one number per era. Beyond 100 VP the track loops. Per-player scorers can record era subtotals via the four categories. Guided inputs are the two era scoring subtotals, not repeated cumulative final marker values. Enter only actual VP penalties lost (cannot lose VP below zero at the time).
